artifacts.notes: Complete page containing Tertia Pars qq. 53-59 in Latin, including q. 59 a. 5 (paragraphs [49523]-[49530]); restricted bytes not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: The Corpus Thomisticum site carries a copyright notice for its electronic presentation; no repository redistribution permission was established. The underlying Leonine text is itself out of copyright, but these exact bytes are the site's presentation.

edition.notes: A dated delivery state of an electronic transcription, registered separately from the Prima Secundae pages already held under this work. The site identifies the text as the Leonine edition; no collation against the printed Leonine volume was performed for this page, and the bracketed paragraph numbers are the site's own. The same site's index does not present the Supplementum as part of this corpus: it heads that section 'Fr. Rainaldus Romanus, Supplementum' and links to an external facsimile instead of a transcription.
edition.publication: Corpus Thomisticum web presentation of the Summa theologiae (Fundacion Tomas de Aquino, ed. E. Alarcon), which identifies its Summa text as the Leonine text; the question-group page covering Tertia Pars qq. 53-59, retrieved 2026-07-25
edition.title: Summa theologiae, Tertia Pars qq. 53-59 — Corpus Thomisticum Latin web state
